title: OFSCP Federation Contact Event (v0.1)
description: Body of POST /api/federation/contacts (§6.7): a user-signed (§4.4) mirror of a contact state change, delivered by the actor's client to the counterparty's home provider. The receiving provider records the corresponding state for its local user `to`.

action.description: `request` opens an incoming pending; `accept` promotes it to accepted; `remove` cancels/declines/removes the relationship.

from.description: The actor performing the action (the signer).

to.description: The counterparty, local to the receiving provider.
